# Test fixtures

Known-good and known-flawed LCA PDFs for the extraction and engine test
suites (TASK-014). The engine's success criterion is measured against these:
100% of planted major errors caught, zero false passes.

## Known-good baseline

- `unrooted-mighty-ginger.pdf` — the real alkatera-generated LCA report for
  UNROOTED Mighty Ginger, Chilli & Baobab Shot 60ml (11 June 2026, v2.0).
  Internally consistent; headline 0.087 kg CO2e, 0% primary data, critical
  review not conducted. Expected tier under the FR-006 rubric: **Bronze**
  (passes all gates; major data-quality gap from 0% primary data).
- `unrooted-mighty-ginger.expected.json` — hand-built expected extraction
  for that report, matching `lcaExtractionSchema`. Used to assert extraction
  accuracy within tolerance.

## Known-flawed variants (synthetic)

Generated by `generate-flawed.mjs` (`node tests/fixtures/generate-flawed.mjs`).
Synthetic text-based reports for a fictional "Test Botanical Drink 250ml";
each contains exactly one planted error, everything else reconciles.

- `flawed-ghg-mismatch.pdf` — GHG species table and lifecycle stages both
  sum to 0.5200 kg CO2e, but the headline claims 0.6100 (~17% off).
  Must fail the calculation-integrity hard gate → Not Certified.
- `flawed-missing-data-quality.pdf` — no data quality section at all
  (ISO 14044 §4.2.3.6). Must produce a major gap / insufficient_info
  finding on §4.2.3.6, never a pass.
- `flawed-wrong-allocation.pdf` — economic allocation applied although
  physical allocation was feasible, with no justification (violates the
  ISO 14044 §4.3.4 hierarchy). Must produce an allocation finding.
